importantNotes: Zephaniah 3:17 is one of the most tender verses in Scripture — God rejoicing over His people with singing.
The 'Day of the LORD' is mentioned more frequently in Zephaniah than any other book.
Zephaniah's royal lineage gave him access to Jerusalem's elite — his message targeted them.
He prophesied during Josiah's reign, possibly helping spark the great reformation.
The book's structure: judgment on Judah → judgment on nations → restoration and joy.

chapters.1: The Day of the LORD is near — total judgment on Judah for idolatry and complacency.
chapters.2: Seek the LORD; judgment on Philistia, Moab, Ammon, Cush, and Assyria.
chapters.3: Woe to corrupt Jerusalem; but God will purify a remnant and rejoice over them with singing.
